sentences.text: Rifa Tamanna vs Unknown on 1 June, 2023

14 
1.
6.2023 adeb CRM (SB) 105 of 2023 In Re:- An application under Section 439(2) of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 arising out of Rajarhat P.S. Case No. 99 of 2023 under Sections 498A/406/506/34 of the IPC.

In the matter of : Rifa Tamanna .......Petitioner Mr. Kamalesh Chandra Saha Ms. Payel Mitra ...for the petitioner This is an application under Section 439(2) of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 against an order dated 26.04.2023 passed by learned Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Barasat in C-382/23 arising out of Rajarhat P.S. Case No. 99 of 2023 under Sections 498A/406/506/34 of the Indian Penal Code.
By the impugned order learned Court below was pleased to grant bail in favour of 4 (four) accused persons.

The petitioner is directed to serve a copy of the application upon the State through the office of the Public Prosecutor and upon the private opposite parties through speed post with acknowledgement due with an intimation that the matter will appear 2(two) weeks after vacation under the same heading.
Let the matter appear two weeks after vacation subject to convenience of the Bench.

(Ajoy Kumar Mukherjee, J.)
